Files: `plugin-detail` (`recordActivityFeed.ts`, `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`, `FieldChangeItem.tsx`, `useDetailTranslation.ts`), 11 locale files, tests in plugin-detail, i18n and one app-shell harness test, one changeset. All inside claim 7089195922's part ② surface.
2. **Premise measured.** At origin/main `activityRowToFeedItem` never read the served field-change code, so a plain edit drew one cut summary line; `fieldChanges` reached the timeline only from `sys_audit_log` on `trackHistory` objects. Card items 1 and 2 were a real gap.
3. **Code read.** `activityFieldChangesOf` parses `metadata.summary_message` (`key: 'fieldChanges'`) into one entry per field and gives up whole on any change it cannot read (the row then draws its summary as before). `fieldChangeLinesOf` draws one `FieldChangeItem` line per served change under the row; the record's creation row is unchanged. Option sides re-read the option label in the reader's language through `fieldOptionLabel`, yes/no reads the pack's word, an empty side reads `detail.fieldChangeEmpty` (「空」). Each side is clamped to one line with an expand/collapse control offered on measured overflow or by length.
4. **Tests and gates.** Dev's run: plugin-detail + i18n + 22 app-shell record-page files, Test Files 543 passed / 1 skipped, Tests 6159 passed; ablation forcing the lines off turned all 8 new pins red in `record-activity.test.tsx`, restored. dispatch-gates 41/41 exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36290-p2-gates-ran.txt`). Check-runs at this head: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check success; `mergeable_state` clean.
5. **Changeset read sentence by sentence** against the diff: each claim (values from the served code, nothing filtered in the browser, empty word, option / lookup / yes-no sides, clamp with control, audit entries drawn alike, creation unchanged, the peek row's compact text now `Label: old → new`) matches the code.
6. **Accepted deviations.** (a) The PR body's readings cite `f281417b`; the two later commits touch only the changeset (`git diff f281417b 633b84e8 -- ui` is empty), and the body patch to update the sha was refused by the relay validator, so the body stays as written. (b) 维护者速读 has four lines per os-dev.md. (c) Screenshots NOT MEASURED (no local backend in the dev's run); the body gives reproduction steps. (d) The package README and its docs page were not edited (outside the part's file surface), named in Acceptance notes.
7. **Out of scope.** The history-card half of the permission acceptance line and the per-field history card go to part ③. Multi-select and tree sides keep stored text (PR 1's accepted deviation). L2 nit on the `tracked` authoring hint (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1688`, from 7080007398) is spec prose outside this card thread's lane; handed to the seat.

Landing: not this thread's to do. Non-governed and under 3000 lines; reported to the seat with this head and the record ids. On merge, `pm:dispatched` stays on #36290 (parts ① and ③ remain).
